description: This file implements an extensible event-driven hook system for managing agent events such as command processing, session lifecycle, message handling, and system startup within the OpenClaw project. It defines event types, context interfaces, registration and triggering mechanisms, and utility functions for handling hooks.

methods.name: registerInternalHook
methods.description: Registers a handler function for a specific event key, enabling it to respond when that event occurs.

methods.name: unregisterInternalHook
methods.description: Removes a previously registered handler for a specific event key.

methods.name: clearInternalHooks
methods.description: Clears all registered hook handlers, useful for testing or resetting.

methods.name: getRegisteredEventKeys
methods.description: Returns an array of all currently registered event keys.

methods.name: hasInternalHookListeners
methods.description: Checks if there are any handlers registered for a given event type and action.

methods.name: triggerInternalHook
methods.description: Executes all handlers registered for the specified event, handling both general type and specific action handlers.

methods.name: createInternalHookEvent
methods.description: Creates a new internal hook event object with specified type, action, session key, and optional context.

methods.name: isAgentBootstrapEvent
methods.description: Type guard to check if an event is an agent bootstrap event with valid context.

methods.name: isGatewayStartupEvent
methods.description: Type guard to check if an event is a gateway startup event.

methods.name: isMessageReceivedEvent
methods.description: Type guard to check if an event is a message received event with valid context.

methods.name: isMessageSentEvent
methods.description: Type guard to check if an event is a message sent event with valid context.

methods.name: isMessageTranscribedEvent
methods.description: Type guard to check if an event is a message transcribed event with valid context.

methods.name: isMessagePreprocessedEvent
methods.description: Type guard to check if an event is a message preprocessed event with valid context.

methods.name: isSessionPatchEvent
methods.description: Type guard to check if an event is a session patch event with valid context.
